posts.title: A Missing Slash Let a Bot Fetch Every Page in Every Theme
posts.description: An empty base URL turned my theme menu’s links into one for every page in every theme, and a bot that ignored robots.txt fetched them all. How I traced it from a JDBC error.

posts.title: Why My TinyMCE Menu Kept Opening Behind Its Window
posts.description: A TinyMCE menu kept opening behind its Kendo window. It took me six tries to fix, and five of them logged success. What finally worked, and what I missed.

posts.title: Why My Checkboxes Never Saved: flushAtRequestEnd and an entitySave Outside the Transaction
posts.description: With flushAtRequestEnd turned off, an entitySave() outside a transaction never reaches the database, and you don’t get an error. Here’s how it quietly broke every Enable checkbox in Galaxie Blog’s theme settings, the wrong guess I made first, and what to look for in your own ColdFusion or Lucee code.
